messages:
amy: Heads-up — can someone take a quick look at PR #4727? It's a small tokenizer padding + KV-cache tweak for nova3b, affects perf with long context. Need to merge before tomorrow's quant rollout. Link: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4727>
chris: on it, will review in ~30m
maria: skimmed — code looks fine but please add a unit test for the padding edge-case (empty prefix). I saw CI flake on similar change last week.
amy: thanks — added test pushed, PTAL. also added bench numbers in PR description: ~8% mem drop, ~2ms median latency improvement for 4k seq.
chris: nice. CI failing on python 3.10 lint: `tests/tokenizer/test_padding.py:14: E303` — can you run `pre-commit`? otherwise i'll fix during merge.
amy: rebased + ran pre-commit, all green locally. pushed fix.
deploy-bot: deploy-sanity: smoke tests queued for dedicated-qa (run id: 7832) — will block merge until pass
rachel: i can do final LGTM once CI passes. would like to see a short note in the changelog about behavior change for pinned dedicated customers.
amy: added changelog entry and tagged @rachel in PR description.
jon: quick question: does this change require model-regression evals? if outputs can shift for long context then buyer-facing tests might be needed.
maria: I don't think semantics change — only padding handling at tokenize-time; but agree run a small eval on internal prompt set after merge.
rachel: :thumbsup: will run evals after merge, ping me if you want the run to be prioritized.
amy: thanks all — aiming to merge after qa smoke. will post update in #eng-oncall.
